crossRefs.note: Saul said, “Bring the burnt offering to me here, and the peace offerings.” He offered the burnt offering.
But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, of the cattle, and of the fat calves, and the lambs…
For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as idolatry and teraphim. Because you have rejected…
He said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have let go out of your hand the man whom I had devoted to destruction…
So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against Yahweh, because of Yahweh’s word, which he didn’t keep; and…
“Cursed is he who does the work of Yahweh negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.
You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you…
“Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

translations.web: Because you didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice, and didn’t execute his fierce wrath on Amalek, therefore Yahweh has done this thing to you today.
translations.bsb: Because you did not obey the LORD or carry out His burning anger against Amalek, the LORD has done this to you today.
translations.kjv: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the LORD, nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath the LORD done this thing unto thee this day.
translations.asv: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of Jehovah, and didst not execute his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath Jehovah done this thing unto thee this day.
